title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Annual follow-up for vascular concern.

HPI
The patient presents for routine follow-up regarding vascular status. Examination notes confirm the presence of a venous insufficiency condition, currently at stage 2. The patient denies any recent changes in symptoms or swelling in the affected limbs since the last visit. They report mild discomfort, which is managed with over-the-counter elevation recommendations. No new skin breakdown or signs of infection are noted by the patient.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily.

Exam
Vascular exam reveals mild varicosities consistent with stage 2 venous insufficiency bilaterally. Skin examination is intact; no open wounds or signs of cellulitis were appreciated. Pedal pulses are 2+/2 bilaterally.

Assessment
Venous insufficiency, stage 2.

Plan
Continue current regimen of lisinopril 10 mg daily. Reinforce leg elevation protocols and recommend wearing compression stockings daily. Follow up in six months or sooner if symptoms worsen.
